_note: Living reference copy of Make.com scenario 9749179's blueprint (v3, Azure + Google Drive + custom render service - the free architecture), for a future Claude session to read without re-fetching. Always re-verify against mcp__Make__scenarios_get before editing anything live - this file can go stale. The Azure Cognitive Services subscription key that belongs in modules 3 and 4 (HTTP header 'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key') is intentionally left as a placeholder in the live scenario until the user pastes a fresh key directly into Make.com's editor - never write the actual key value into this repo, and never ask the user for it in chat. v2 (JSON2Video-based) was tried and reverted: JSON2Video's cheapest non-annual plan ($49/month) was well over the user's ~₦20,000/month budget for this pipeline, while Azure's free tier comfortably covers the ~90 videos/month this schedule produces.
name: Next Level Education - Storytelling Video Agent (Claude)
status: Deliberately left INACTIVE - the Azure key is a placeholder. Activate only after the user confirms they've pasted a working key into Make.com.

flow.purpose: Writes the story: {narration, caption, video_theme} as strict JSON. See SKILL.md for the compliance rule this prompt encodes (no raw link/disclosure in the caption).
Parses module 1's JSON string output into narration/caption/video_theme fields.
Fetches a short-lived Azure Cognitive Services auth token for text-to-speech.

headers.name: Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key
headers.value: PLACEHOLDER - user must paste a fresh key directly into Make.com

flow.purpose: Calls Azure TTS with the narration text (SSML), Nigerian-English voice en-NG-EzinneNeural, returns MP3 audio bytes.
Uploads the narration MP3 to Google Drive so it has a fetchable URL.
Makes the uploaded MP3 publicly readable so the video-merge microservice can fetch it by URL.
Calls the user's own render microservice with a background clip URL (picked by keyword-matching video_theme+narration against clips c01-c19) and the narration audio URL; returns a merged MP4.
Posts the merged video to the Next Level Education Facebook Page. Caption has URLs and any disclosure/affiliate wording stripped - the disclosure lives in the comment instead (module 12).
Waits 90 seconds for Facebook to finish processing the video into a commentable post before the next step runs. Raise this if CreateComment keeps failing with 'object does not exist'.
Comments the disclosed affiliate link underneath the post.
